snippet.title: Into the Fire - "What We Bring Back" - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Face the cataclysm. Choose what you bring back.
Watch the new gameplay trailer “What We Bring Back”, which premiered during IGN Fan Fest 2026.

Race an erupting volcano in a high-risk extraction survival where every second counts - Into the Fire
Rescue survivors, manage scarce resources, survive escalating fire anomalies, and carve escape routes through ash, lava, and collapsing ruins. Every life you bring back strengthens your Hub.
Every failed extraction reshapes what remains. What would you bring back from the flames?

Wishlist Into the Fire now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2988030/Into_the_Fire/

Into the Fire launches in Early Access in 2026.
